operation_details.item: The campaign was originally planned to launch in June.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the campaign timing looking for this quarter?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It was originally planned to launch in June, but that timeline shifted.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We needed extra time to finish the new creative, so the campaign is now planned to launch in July.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a worthwhile tradeoff if the creative is stronger. Is the new timing settled?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the July launch date is locked in the campaign calendar.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great—having the date locked should make the remaining coordination easier.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Now we can focus on the final rollout details and customer engagement work.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original June launch plan and retain the current July plan and its rationale.
